title: Olive Oil Refried Beans
summary: Pinto beans simmered with golden onion and garlic, then mashed creamy and served with tortilla chips.

ingredients.item: x 400 g cans pinto beans, rinsed and drained
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Cook the onion, garlic and chilli in the oil over medium heat 8-10 min until golden.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the beans and water and boil 5 min.

steps.title: Mash
steps.text: Take out the chilli and mash the beans in the pan, stirring and scraping, until thick and creamy.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Stir in the salt; the beans thicken further as they stand, so loosen with a splash of water if needed.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Swirl into a bowl, scatter with coriander and serve with tortilla chips.

tips: Mash in the pan so the beans keep cooking as you work.
Add water a spoon at a time if they get too thick.
Good in tacos and burritos too.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 4 days; reheat with a splash of water. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
